subject: AppSec retainer renewal + proposed scope adjustments
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <talvarez@adeptsec.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AppSec retainer renewal + proposed scope adjustments

Hi Tom,

Hope you're well — our annual retainer with AdeptSec is up for renewal at the end of April (current SOW expires 2027-04-30). Before we loop procurement, I wanted to confirm a couple of scope adjustments we discussed on the call last week and see if you can provide an updated SOW and pricing that reflects them:

- Add web-app runtime instrumentation verification (lightweight dynamic checks) to the standard red-team cadence (quarterly).
- Move from a single 3-day red-team window to two smaller 2-day windows to reduce blast impact on staging.
- Add one fractional pen-test for a new internal microservice (up to 40 hours) to the retainer bucket.
- Reduce evidence delivery delay from 14 days to 7 days for critical findings.

Can AdeptSec accept the above as adjustments to the standard retainer line item, and provide a v2 SOW with pricing differences itemized? If you can include a DocuSign-ready version, procurement will expedite approval.

Also copying Tessa for scheduling constraints and Marcus for budget coordination.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Alvarez <talvarez@adeptsec.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@adeptsec.com
Date: 2027-03-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AppSec retainer renewal + proposed scope adjustments

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear summary. Really appreciate the call recap.

We can accommodate all four items; I've attached a draft SOW (AdeptSec_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short redline that shows incremental costs. High level:

- Instrumentation verification: +15% to the annual retainer fee (tool-usage pass-through capped at $5k).
- Two 2-day red-team windows: no change to total days, scheduling fee waived for two-window model.
- Fractional pen-test (40 hours): we can roll into the retainer at $12,000, or do ad-hoc; proposal tags it as a retainer add-on.
- Critical-finding SLA: we can commit to a 7-day evidence delivery for P1/P2 with an SLA clause; that will be reflected in the SOW and the SLA appendix.

Attachments: AdeptSec_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW), pricing_redline.xlsx (line-item changes).

If that looks right, I can generate a DocuSign package and a separate operational checklist for the staging windows.

Best,
Tom Alvarez
Head of Client Delivery | AdeptSec Security Services
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Alvarez <talvarez@adeptsec.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AppSec retainer renewal + proposed scope adjustments

Forwarding AdeptSec's draft and pricing. Tom attached a v3 SOW and a pricing redline — please review the two short items I highlighted inline.

Neha / Marcus — specific asks:

1) Budget: can we absorb the +15% instrumentation line and the $12k fractional test within the FY27 security ops budget? Marcus, if we need to move funds, what's the fastest route?
2) Contract terms: Neha, AdeptSec added an SLA appendix with a 7-day evidence delivery for critical findings; they also kept liability and IP clauses as before. I proposed a small change to limit post-engagement snapshot retention to 90 days in the redline. Can you review the attached pricing_redline.xlsx and the SOW appendix (highlighted)?

Tom — two quick vendor clarifications we need before we send to procurement: 1) Can AdeptSec accept our standard data handling addendum (I pasted the clause below), and 2) confirm the retention/handling approach for logs harvested during instrumentation verification.

-- pasted clause (from Redwood standard DPA): "Vendor will not retain customer-identifying data beyond 90 days unless otherwise required by law. Any retained logs must be encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys on request."

Thanks,
Chloe

Subject: Re: Fwd: AppSec retainer renewal + proposed scope adjustments

Thanks everyone — reviewed the SOW and the redline. Two short items from legal/procurement perspective:

1) We will approve the instrumentation add-on and the fractional 40h test as a one-time retainer expansion for FY27. Budget approved — Marcus, please allocate the $12k from the product incident mitigation reserve.
2) AdeptSec must accept Redwood's data handling addendum (the 90-day retention + encryption at rest, customer-managed keys on request). We also need AdeptSec to agree to a short SLA credit for missed evidence deadlines (e.g., 5% monthly credit for any missed P1 delivery beyond 7 days, capped at retainer value).

Tom — if you can confirm acceptance of the DPA clause and add the SLA credit language into the SOW appendix, we can route the DocuSign to procurement and finalize by 2027-04-07. If you prefer, we can limit the SLA credit to the first year as a compromise.

Assuming acceptance, procurement will need the DocuSign packet and a signed W-9 (or local equivalent) to complete the vendor record.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
